detail.what: S3.0 was run against goal-mic-20260919-001-r1 and its record was not written. The screen itself completed and is reproducible: 4 candidates (confocal, transmitted, widefield_inline, widefield_side), 1 rejected (trapping, on role), cap 3, cap_unresolved true, fan_out empty.
detail.why_not_written: the card asks for degraded [] with kb_refs and kb_gaps filled from real calls, and three of its four completion clauses are contradicted by the contract and the harness rather than by the screen. Writing the record anyway would spend this question's first revision on a degraded pin, which is the one thing the card says it is trying to avoid (9.1 has never been met for this qid and could be met by its first card).
blockers: screening.py librarian_service_available() returns False unconditionally. Its own docstring calls itself the one line to change when the MCP server exists; the server has existed since a9df017 on 2026-09-18. So no screening card can carry degraded [] today, in any session.

this session has no librarian tools at all. session_connectors_status lists only scheduled-tasks; the root .claude/settings.local.json carries disabledMcpjsonServers ['librarian'], which overrides enabledMcpjsonServers ['librarian'] at the user level. A session at this same cwd held the server until 2026-09-20T00:19:47Z, when it exited cleanly after 60628s, so this is a settings change and not the server path 8d4a604 fixed. Settings are read at session start, so no running session can clear it.

screening.schema.json declares no kb_refs and no kb_gaps and sets additionalProperties false, so the artifact the card asks for cannot carry the two fields the card requires. It declares no status either, so 'configs.json is VALIDATED' has nothing to be written into. Both are contracts/ and manager-microscope's.
detail.also: the card asks for seven caller_ids, mic-20260919-001:v1:<config>:<axis>. None can be issued: the schema invariant empties fan_out whenever the cap is unresolved, and the cap is unresolved because four configurations survive a cap of three. The card's own 'if more survive, stop and ask' is the clause that fired.
detail.what_would_close_it: two things from the person, and they are independent. (1) Enable the librarian for this session's project path and restart the session, which closes blocker 2; blocker 1 is then this seat's to fix and blocker 3 is manager-microscope's. (2) State the sample's contrast set on the goal card, or a configuration_preference, either of which resolves the cap. The goal card already names sample_contrast as deliberately absent and for the person, and it predicts this exact stop.
detail.not_an_error: the stop at the cap is the correct outcome and not a defect. All four priority terms on the goal card -- physical_feasibility, target_accuracy, evidence_grade, cost -- are produced by S3, so none can decide whether S3 runs; cutting on any of them would drop a candidate on no grounds (P16).
